colleges.name: University of Maryland
notes: outOfStateAdmitRate omitted. In the CDS 2025-26 C1 residency table the International column is blank and in-state + out-of-state equals the total (applied 18,487 + 48,614 = 67,101; admitted 8,075 + 22,143 = 30,218). International applicants are therefore inside the out-of-state figure and cannot be separated (UMD enrolled 238 first-year nonresidents per B1). The combined out-of-state + international rate is 22,143 / 48,614 = 0.4555. It was not used.
CDS 2024-25 (https://irpa.umd.edu/InstitutionalData/CommonDataSet/CDS_2024-2025.xlsx) leaves the residency table blank.
Same CDS overall C1: 30,218 admitted / 67,101 applied = 0.4503 (2025-26).

colleges.name: University of Michigan
notes: No official residency split found. The CDS 2025-26 (https://obp.umich.edu/wp-content/uploads/pubdata/cds/cds_2025-26_umaa.pdf) and CDS 2024-25 (https://obp.umich.edu/wp-content/uploads/pubdata/cds/CDS_2024-25_UMAA.pdf) both leave the C1 residency table (In-State/Out-of-State/International) blank and report totals only.
Third-party sites quote ~39% in-state / ~18% out-of-state but give no official source, so they were not used. obp.umich.edu listing pages and record.umich.edu returned 403 to automated fetches.

colleges.name: University of South Florida
notes: 2025-26 CDS (https://www.usf.edu/ods/documents/cds/usf-cds-2025-2026-final-v2.pdf) C1 residency table as published: in-state 7,283 applied / 5,533 admitted / 5,484 enrolled; out-of-state 63,880 / 23,170 / 759; international 559 / 493 / 487; total 71,722 / 29,196 / 6,730 (overall 0.4071, matches stored rate). Left unrecorded because the table is internally implausible: in-state yield would be 99% (5,484 of 5,533 admits) and out-of-state yield 3%, suggesting the in-state and out-of-state applied/admitted cells are swapped. 2024-25 CDS (https://www.usf.edu/ods/documents/cds/cds-2024-2025-final.pdf) shows the same pattern (in-state 7,508 / 5,640 / 5,578; out-of-state 60,474 / 23,447 / 802). Literal reading: in-state 0.7597, out-of-state 0.3627; swapped reading: in-state 0.3627, out-of-state 0.7597. Needs a human decision; not estimated.
